weapon_seen: sickle-crook staff in right hand
direction: Crook staff tips forward and fires; robe stays planted.

name: Faerie Dragon
weapon_seen: small four-legged winged lizard; mouth, no weapon
direction: Head pulls back then snaps forward spitting a bolt while the tall wings flare; bite is a melee clip on a 350-range unit, and the body (4 legs + wings) is a drake, not a wyrm; if it must stay wyrm it needs NEW:wyrm_spit (same motion).

name: Glaive Thrower
weapon_seen: griffin-shaped cart with a rotor glaive on top
direction: Cart kicks back on its wheels as the glaive launches from the top.

name: Northern Yeti Builder
weapon_seen: pickaxe over right shoulder, tool in left fist; bearded goggled dwarf (not a yeti)
direction: Pickaxe swings from the shoulder in a full overhead arc and bites down; the pick head is the silhouette.

name: Wandigoo
weapon_seen: long ape arms with claws, no weapon
direction: One long arm whips across the front as a claw swipe, then a straight jab with the other; arms lead, torso only twists (dual-wield clips assume held blades).

name: Ancient Wandigoo
weapon_seen: huge ape arms with claws, spiked back, no weapon
direction: Wide claw swipe, then both fists up and slammed down, then a jab; heavier and slower than the Wandigoo.

name: Hrimthrusa
weapon_seen: ice-tipped harpoon in right hand, lantern in left
direction: Harpoon arm cocks back over the shoulder and hurls overhand; lantern hand stays low.

name: Angry Hrimthrusa
weapon_seen: harpoons in a back quiver, lantern in right hand, ice mallet in left
direction: Reaches over the shoulder and hurls overhand as if drawing a harpoon from the back quiver.

name: Azure Drake
weapon_seen: dragon maw, wings (natural)
direction: Neck draws back, then stretches forward with open jaws; wings spread on the exhale.

name: Frost Wolf
weapon_seen: jaws (harnessed wolf)
direction: Head snaps forward and down in a quick bite; front legs brace, body does not leap.

name: Polar Bear
weapon_seen: front paws and jaws (natural), collar
direction: One heavy paw swats across; shoulders roll into it, hind legs planted.

name: Magnataur
weapon_seen: large axe-hammer in right hand, anvil on back; mammoth-taur with tusks
direction: Big one-hand hammer-axe arcs overhead and across; four legs stay planted, weapon arm leads.

name: Ice Queen
weapon_seen: tall lantern staff in right hand
direction: Lantern staff thrusts forward to fire the frost bolt; coat stays upright.

name: Ice Troll Shadow Priest
weapon_seen: hammer-headed staff in right hand, ice lantern in left

name: Ice Troll Witch Doctor
weapon_seen: golden crook staff in right hand
direction: Crook staff tips forward and fires; hunched troll stance kept.

name: Orc Peon Builder
weapon_seen: long shovel-headed tool over right shoulder, bucket at hip

name: Grunt
weapon_seen: one short axe in right hand
direction: One-hand axe cuts diagonal, flat, then overhead; left arm free.

name: Veteran Grunt
weapon_seen: ONE hafted axe in right hand, left hand empty; horned helmet
direction: Leaping one-hand axe chop as the signature hit, then a plain chop and a flat cut; two-hand clips swing an empty second hand.

name: Axemaster
weapon_seen: short haft/club in right hand, black gold-trimmed shield in left
direction: Weapon arm chops and cuts, then the black shield punches forward; no double axe on the model.

name: Shaman
weapon_seen: skull-topped staff in right hand
direction: Skull staff thrusts forward to fire.

name: Blood Shaman
weapon_seen: staff with a glowing box lantern head, blood sack on back
direction: Staff points and fires; hunched under the sack.

name: Infostealer
weapon_seen: staff with a brazier/funnel head in left hand, big pipe on back
direction: Staff head thrusts forward to fire; cast comes from the staff, not from an eye amulet.

name: Catapult
weapon_seen: covered wagon with a flaming pot on a throwing arm
direction: Wagon rocks back on its wheels as the arm flings the burning pot.

name: Kodo
weapon_seen: big nose horn, teeth; rhino-like pack beast
direction: Head dips and hooks the horn upward into the target, alternated with a snapping bite; only neck and shoulders move, no full-body drive forward.

name: Melee Kodo Rider
weapon_seen: rider with one axe raised; rhino mount with horn
direction: Rider axe chops down past the mount's shoulder, then cuts across; mount holds still.

name: Defensive Kodo Rider
weapon_seen: rider with round red shield raised and a spear; rhino mount
direction: Rider jabs the spear down past the mount's head from behind the raised shield, then a sideways cut; drop charge_lance, the gallop-in-place reads as a body tackle.

name: Spellbreaker Kodo Rider
weapon_seen: rider in steel helmet with an upright spear; armoured rhino mount
direction: Rider thrusts the spear forward and down, then sweeps it across; there is no drum or mace on the model.

name: Troll Berserker
weapon_seen: two cleavers, one in each hand
direction: Cleaver arm winds back and hurls overhand; the other cleaver stays low.

name: Troll Trapper
weapon_seen: two cleavers, one in each hand; no net launcher or gun
direction: Overhand cleaver throw, arm cocked behind the head then snapped forward; two-hand gun pose has nothing to hold.

name: Forest Troll Trapper
weapon_seen: spear on back, coiled rope/net in right hand, skull at belt; no gun
direction: Overhand javelin/net throw from behind the shoulder with a forward step of the torso; two-hand shoot and burst clips have no gun to hold.

name: Wyvern Rider
weapon_seen: goblin rider with bayonet rifle on a winged lion mount (no spear)
direction: Mount hovers steady while the rider shoulders the rifle and fires with a visible kick-back of the upper body; nothing is thrown.

name: Pandaren Panda Builder
weapon_seen: wooden mallet in one hand, lantern in the other
direction: Short overhand mallet taps from the elbow, the big straw hat stays level so only the mallet arc moves.

name: Ironpaw Militia
weapon_seen: rifle with a long bayonet held like a pike
direction: Two-hand bayonet lunge: rifle levels from upright to horizontal and stabs forward with a front-foot step, then a short sideways butt/blade sweep.

name: Ironpaw Guardian
weapon_seen: tall pole with a T-shaped head (mash paddle), heavy gauntlets
direction: The T-head is blunt so it must come down overhead like a long hammer, then a wide waist-high sweep, then the whirlwind spin; no thrust.

name: Drunken Brewmaster
weapon_seen: green jerrycan in one hand with hose to a back keg (no mug)

name: Echofoot Mystic
weapon_seen: folding war fan in one hand, red teapot in the other
direction: Fan arm winds across the chest and snaps open outward in a flat arc that sends the pulse, alternating with a palm push; body stays planted.

name: Jade Elder
weapon_seen: jade glaive polearm held upright, urn and keg on back
direction: Glaive tip dips back then snaps forward at the target to flick the jade bolt off the blade; the pole never leaves the hand.

name: Sagepaw Monk
weapon_seen: red staff with a disc head in one hand
direction: Staff head tilts forward toward the target and jabs to release the missile, alternating with a free-hand push; robe barely moves.

name: Sagepaw Soulkeeper
weapon_seen: long ladle in one hand, portable stove carried in front, red pot on back
direction: Ladle dips toward the stove then whips overarm to fling the healing glob; the overarm arc is the read.

name: Brewshock Catapult
weapon_seen: steam-boiler mortar cannon on two big wheels
direction: Barrel kicks back and the carriage rocks on its wheels with a smoke puff; long settle to match the 6 s cooldown.

name: Cloud Ship
weapon_seen: teapot-hull junk airship with broadside arrow launchers and red sail
direction: Hull rolls slightly away from the firing side as the broadside racks let go; sail stays the stable silhouette.

name: Undead Acolyte Builder
weapon_seen: long iron hook (boat hook / crowbar) in one hand, satchel
direction: Hook is swung overhead and dragged back like a pick, not hammered; the pull-back toward the body is the accent.

name: Zombie
weapon_seen: hatchet / entrenching tool in one hand, gas flask on chest
direction: Loose, late-arriving hatchet chops with the shoulder dropping after each swing; arm leads, body lags.

name: Suffocated Zombie
weapon_seen: pitchfork in one hand, sack over head, breathing bag
direction: Both hands level the pitchfork and jab the tines forward at gut height, then a clumsy sideways shove with the shaft; no hug-slam.

name: Plague Bearer
weapon_seen: meat hook with a block weight on a short chain in one hand; bloated body with gas tank
direction: Hook-and-weight swings overhand and across on a heavy arm while the belly counter-sways; slow wind-up for the 2 s cooldown.

name: Vampire
weapon_seen: bare long-fingered claws on both hands, hooded purple coat; NO wings on the model
direction: Family should be biped (concept has no wings for the harpy rig to drive); alternating downward claw rakes with a forward lean, then a crossing two-hand slash.

name: Vampire Lord
weapon_seen: large claws on both hands, horns, big bat wings on the back
direction: Winged body on biped leaves the wings dead; harpy family fits (swap with h01U); X-slash with both claws, single deep rake, then both claws down while wings flare on the hit.

name: Necromancer
weapon_seen: cane topped with a green lantern in one hand, book in the other
direction: Hunched caster lifts the lantern cane off the ground and jabs its head at the target to loose the bolt; book arm stays tucked.

name: Mighty Necromancer
weapon_seen: tall staff with green flame head, green fire in the free hand
direction: Fire hand pushes a bolt forward, next attack the flaming staff head tips and jabs at the target; green accents must lead each motion.

name: Lich King
weapon_seen: cane with green canister head in one hand, book in the other (no sword)
direction: Note is stale: there is no sword; the cane head points and jabs to send the frost bolt, alternating with an open-hand push.

name: Banshee
weapon_seen: no weapon; gloved hands, masked face under wide hat, floating
direction: Both gloved hands thrust forward from the chest as the body rocks back, like pushing the scream out.

name: Flesh Golem
weapon_seen: huge blocky metal gauntlet fist on one arm, big hook hand on the other, horned helm
direction: Block fist rises overhead and hammers down, then a straight haymaker, then the hook arm swipes flat; each uses a different arm path so the three read apart.

name: Frost Wyrm
weapon_seen: skeletal frost dragon, jaws glowing blue, four legs and wings
direction: Neck coils back then extends with open jaws for the frost cone while wings hold a slow beat.

name: Twin Weeper
weapon_seen: spoked valve wheel gripped in one hand, fat hooded body, weeping mask (no daggers)
direction: Single-hand bludgeon: wheel comes over the top and then swings flat like a discus held in the fist; drop the dual-dagger clips.

name: Twin Smiley
weapon_seen: book / tablet clutched to the chest, smiling mask (no daggers)
direction: Ranged unit with no blades: one hand leaves the book and pushes the bolt forward; the book stays against the chest.

name: Hydra
weapon_seen: three snapping heads on a coiled legless serpent body
melee_or_ranged: unknown (no range in stats); necks strike
direction: Heads strike in turn, one neck whipping forward and down while the other two rear back; the coil stays planted.

name: Lesser Hydra
weapon_seen: two snapping heads on a coiled legless serpent body
melee_or_ranged: unknown (no range in stats); necks strike
direction: Left and right heads alternate lunging bites, the idle head pulls back as counterweight.

name: Lesser Vampire
weapon_seen: dagger in one hand, trench coat, small folded wings
direction: Quick short dagger jabs from the hip with a small flat cut between them; not two-handed claw slashes.

name: Ghoul
weapon_seen: long claws on both oversized hands, hunched knuckle-walker
direction: Stays hunched: one long arm rakes down and across from above the head, then both arms cross; arms lead, torso does not ram.

name: Greater Ghoul
weapon_seen: heavy clawed gauntlets on both ape-like arms, skull hood
direction: Heavier version: slow single-arm rake then both gauntlets hammer down together.

name: Lich Ghoul
weapon_seen: very long white talons on both arms, hunched, feathered cloak, green orb in chest
direction: Fast alternating talon rakes, crossing slash, then both talons spear forward; white claws must trace visible arcs.

name: Treant
weapon_seen: big clawed wooden hands on long arms, tree-trunk body
direction: A tree does not kick: one branch arm swings a straight punch, then both arms lift and one fist hammers down.

name: Long Range Catapult
weapon_seen: long-barrel field gun on a two-wheel carriage
direction: Long barrel slides back on the carriage and the trail digs in; slow return.

name: Summoned Lobster
weapon_seen: two large pincer claws, antenna eyes, crab legs
direction: Family should be crustacean (has pinch): one claw opens wide, reaches and snaps shut on the target; the mouth bite of crawler shows nothing.

name: Raised Tentacle
weapon_seen: hook-tipped tentacle stalk rooted in a sewer grate, small side tendrils
direction: Stalk bends back then whips its hooked tip down and forward; base never moves.

name: Mutation
weapon_seen: big tar-black fists on a hulking body, exposed ribcage
direction: Heavy alternating blows: straight haymaker, then an overhead fist hammer; drop the kick, the legs stay rooted.

name: Forest Spirit
weapon_seen: floating seed pod with glowing orb and dangling tendrils; no arms
direction: Wraith arm clips have no arms to move; a tendril family such as ray (lash) or shard (strike) fits: pod tips back and the tendrils whip forward under it.

name: Forest Spider
weapon_seen: fangs under green eye cluster, eight legs
direction: Fast head-down fang snap with the front leg pair lifting, sized for the 0.75 s cooldown.

name: Ultimate Builder
weapon_seen: tall lantern staff in one hand, hooded horned figure
direction: No hammer on the model: lantern staff is held out and the free hand channels at the work; lantern light is the accent.

name: Feathered Friend (perk)

direction: Quick forward peck from hover, head darts and returns while wings keep beating.

name: Skeleton Warrior

direction: Club comes straight over the top, then diagonal, then the shield plate punches forward; blunt club so no flat slicing.

name: Skeleton Archer
weapon_seen: bolt-action rifle held in both hands (no bow)
direction: Shoulders the rifle, brief aim hold, shot with a small recoil; bow draw is wrong for this model.

name: Skeletal Mage
weapon_seen: staff topped with a green lantern, gas mask on chest
direction: Lantern head leans to the target and jabs to throw the bolt, alternating with a bony free-hand push.

name: Skeletal Hero

direction: Big overhead axe chop, waist sweep, spin; keep them tight for the 0.85 s cooldown.

name: Greater Skeleton Warrior
weapon_seen: two-hand sledgehammer (no sword), helmet and pauldrons
direction: Sledge rises over the shoulder and drops straight down with a knee bend, then a low two-hand side swing.

name: Greater Skeleton Archer
weapon_seen: long rifle held in both hands (no bow), coat and helmet
direction: Rifle levels from the vertical carry to the shoulder and fires; long barrel line is the read.

name: Greater Skeletal Mage
weapon_seen: two-hand staff with a forked head, pack on back
direction: Both hands tilt the forked staff forward and jab; the bolt leaves from between the prongs.

name: Skeletal General
weapon_seen: one-hand sword, green lantern in the off hand, plate armour and cape
direction: One-hand fencing cuts: diagonal, flat, then a thrust, lantern arm held back; two-hand clips would glue the lantern hand to the hilt.
